name: Italian Studies Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students will have to complete 12 lower division units and a minimum of 15 upper division units to obtain the minor in Italian studies.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The following required courses are taken in sequence.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements (15 units)

requirements.title: 2 of ENGL 377, ENGL 378, HIST 402 and 5 more

sections.note: Note: Some of the above courses have specific prerequisites and it is the student's responsibility to ensure that all prerequisites are met for upper division courses listed in the program.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Exemption from 100 division Italian language courses may be granted up to a maximum of six units on evidence of language proficiency.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students who hope to gain course exemption must consult with the program coordinator.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students will be required to complete the equivalent number of exempted units from the following list of courses.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: In addition to the normal university degree requirements, students must obtain a minimum 2.00 ITAL cumulative grade point average (CGPA) (calculated on all ITAL courses completed at SFU), and a minimum 2.00 ITAL CUDGPA (calculated on all upper division ITAL courses completed at SFU).

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: For all bachelor of arts (BA) programs, students complete 120 units, which includes at least 60 units that must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 45 upper division units, of which at least 30 upper division units must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 60 units (including 21 upper division units) in Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences courses satisfaction of the writing, quantitative, and breadth requirements an overall cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division overall CGPA of at least 2.0, and program CGPA and upper division program CGPA of at least 2.0 on the course work used to satisfy the minimum program requirements.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: FASS departments may define additional GPA requirements for their respective programs.
